en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a tall stone monument built from rough boulders and dressed masonry. At the top stands a winged female figure (an angel or allegorical Victory) holding up a long cross with a double crossbar. Midway up the plinth there is a niche with a carved cross. Heavy chains hang between stone posts around the base, and trees are visible in the background. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the front.
